spec.label: Endpoint

spec.name: flight_mode
spec.description: Mode sent by the Set flight mode command
spec.label: Flight mode

options.content:
Survey drone
Quadcopter flight operations from Yamcs instance demo

spec.title: Callsign
spec.description: String parameter set by the simulator.

spec.title: Flight mode
spec.description: EMERGENCY raises a critical alarm in Yamcs.

spec.title: Motors
spec.description: Armed state; propellers can spin when armed.

spec.title: Failsafe
spec.description: Failsafe takes control when it becomes active.

spec.title: Mission elapsed
spec.description: Seconds since the mission started, shown as a clock.

spec.title: Vehicle
spec.description: Canvas drone element: rotors spin at their live RPM and the body turns with yaw. Motor temperatures use the Yamcs alarm ranges.

spec.title: Flight path
spec.description: Geomap route over satellite imagery; color follows altitude.

spec.title: Altitude
spec.description: Measured altitude against the commanded target; dashed limits come from Yamcs.

spec.title: Attitude
spec.description: Canvas drone elements tilt with roll (front view) and pitch (side view).

spec.title: Battery
spec.description: State of charge with the Yamcs warning and critical ranges.

spec.title: Battery pack
spec.description: Battery pack readings, each against its Yamcs warning and critical ranges.

spec.title: Power bus
spec.description: Battery output, remaining energy and the three regulated rail voltages.

spec.title: Cell voltages
spec.description: Each cell against the Yamcs per-cell warning (3.4-4.25 V) and critical ranges.

spec.title: Pack voltage
spec.description: Dashed lines are the Yamcs limits.

spec.title: Pack current
spec.description: Dashed lines are the Yamcs limits.

spec.title: Branch current
spec.description: PowerDistribution.branchCurrents, one bar per branch.

spec.title: Branch switches
spec.description: Enable flag of each power branch over time.

spec.title: Power faults
spec.description: Fault codes; undervoltage and disconnect are critical in Yamcs.

spec.title: Motor speed
spec.description: Motors[i].rpm for all four motors.

spec.title: Motor temperature
spec.description: Dashed lines are the Yamcs warning and critical limits.

spec.title: Throttle
spec.description: Motors[i].throttle.

spec.title: Motor current
spec.description: Motors[i].current against the Yamcs current ranges.

spec.title: Motor status
spec.description: Enumerated status; DEGRADED warns and FAULT is critical in Yamcs.

spec.title: Vibration spectrum
spec.description: MotorVibrationSpectrum[motor][band], a two-dimensional array in g.

spec.title: Angular rates
spec.description: AngularRates aggregate members.

spec.title: Commands
spec.description: Flight commands; arguments come from the dashboard variables.

command-1.label: Set mode ${flight_mode}
command-1.tooltip: Sends SetFlightMode with the flight mode variable

command-2.label: Climb to ${target_altitude} m
command-2.tooltip: Sends SetTargetAltitude with the target altitude variable

command-3.label: Test motor ${motor}
command-3.tooltip: Spins the selected motor at 15% for 2 seconds

command-4.label: Geofence 150 m
command-4.tooltip: 150 m radius, 100 m ceiling, return home at 40 m on breach

spec.title: Last command
spec.description: Command acknowledgement reported by the vehicle.

spec.title: Data links
spec.description: Yamcs data links, with enable, disable and reset actions.
Keeps the dashboard time range on Yamcs mission time.

spec.title: Camera
spec.description: Image URL telemetry from /drone/CameraImageUrl.

spec.title: Command history
spec.description: Commands with their acknowledgements.

spec.title: Events
spec.description: Yamcs events, newest first.
